fact: On 19 February 2024 the Rwanda Standards Board published in the Official Gazette as national standards ISO/IEC 25000:2014 and ISO/IEC/IEEE 8802-1AB, 8802-3 and 8802-22 on information technology.
title: Official Gazette n° 08 of 19/02/2024: National Standards
publisher: Rwanda Standards Board, Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
